snippet.title: AION 2 Developer Diary - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393110/AION_2/

During the Future Games Show at gamescom, developers NC took us behind the curtain for an overview of AION 2, the Unreal Engine 5 MMORPG where the sky is your battlefield. There's a launch-scale test held on September 17 & 18 next month, ahead of the game's October 5 launch on PC.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
